content.title: About
content.content: Iced instant black tea, unsweetened, is a fast‑dissolving beverage made from selected black tea leaves. After extraction and drying, the leaves become a fine powder that easily dissolves in cold water, allowing you to prepare a refreshing drink in seconds.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Black tea contains more caffeine than green tea and is often used for an energy boost.
Instant tea was invented in the early 20th century for the convenience of soldiers and travelers.
Without added sugar, the tea retains the natural leaf flavor and aroma of traditional brewed tea.
The powder is easy to transport and store – no refrigeration needed until preparation.
Black tea is rich in polyphenols, giving the drink a slightly astringent taste.

items.title: Improves alertness
items.content: Caffeine in black tea stimulates the central nervous system, enhancing concentration and reaction time.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Polyphenols such as theaflavins and thearubigins help combat free radicals.

items.title: Supports cardiovascular health
items.content: Moderate, regular consumption of black tea may help lower LDL cholesterol levels.

items.title: Hydration without extra calories
items.content: An unsweetened drink quenches thirst without adding sugar or calories.

items.title: Aids digestion
items.content: Tannins in tea can help regulate stomach function.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Impact on iron absorption
items.content: Tannins can reduce the absorption of non‑heme iron from plant foods, so avoid drinking tea with meals.

items.title: Allergy to tea components
items.content: Rarely, allergic reactions to tea leaf compounds can occur.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Dissolve one teaspoon of powder in 250 ml of cold water and stir well. Optionally add a slice of lemon, mint, or a sweetener. Drink promptly after preparation to enjoy the fresh aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the powder in a sealed package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Prevent moisture to avoid clumping during long‑term storage.
